generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The Coalesce evaluator does not handle all possible data type conversions and may throw unexpected errors for unsupported types.

The test cases for Coalesce do not cover all possible data types and scenarios, leading to potential gaps in functionality.
#### Potential performance issues in Block.copyFrom methods

The new `copyFrom` methods may lead to inefficiencies when handling large datasets due to repeated value checks and copies.
#### Incomplete error handling in Coalesce evaluator

The note about async-profiler compatibility should be moved to the main documentation or a dedicated section for troubleshooting. This will ensure users are aware of the requirement when setting up profiling.
#### Inconsistent test coverage for Coalesce function
